data.one_liner: Flutter icon pack providing Remix icons as IconData.
data.what_it_does: Provides the full Remix Icon set as Flutter IconData constants. Allows you to replace Material icons with a modern, MIT‑licensed alternative. Works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need a large collection of ready‑made icons without external assets
You want a drop‑in replacement for Material icons with a different visual style
You require a single‑dependency solution for icons across mobile, web, and desktop
avoid_when: You need platform‑specific icons not covered by Remix
You require animated or SVG icons that change at runtime
strengths: Simple API – just import and use IconData
MIT license suitable for commercial use
weaknesses: Limited to the Remix icon set only
No support for SVG or animated icons

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similarly large, well‑known icon set with many community resources
